title: The divergence of a compactly supported C¹ vector field integrates to zero
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ and every C¹ map φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (ContDiff ℝ 1) with compact support, ∫_{ℝ^P} trace(Dφ(z)) dL^P(z) = 0. Here Dφ(z) = fderiv ℝ φ z, viewed as a linear map ℝ^P → ℝ^P, and L^P = volume.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ z, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = 0
